| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |

| Injection | `isInjectionEnabled` | choice |  |  |
| Mode | `injectionMode` | choice |  | This is where the fuel injection type is defined: "Simultaneous" means all injectors will fire together at once. "Sequential" fires the injectors on a per cylinder basis, which requires individually wired injectors. "Batched" will fire the injectors in groups. |
| Alpha-N uses IAT density correction | `alphaNUseIat` | choice |  | When set to yes, it enables intake air temperature-based corrections for Alpha-N tuning strategies. |
| Override VE table load axis | `veOverrideMode` | choice |  | Override the Y axis (load) value used for the VE table. Advanced users only: If you aren't sure you need this, you probably don't need this. |
| Override AFR table load axis | `afrOverrideMode` | choice |  | Override the Y axis (load) value used for the AFR table. Advanced users only: If you aren't sure you need this, you probably don't need this. |
| Injection timing control mode | `injectionTimingMode` | choice |  | Selects which point of the nominal injector pulse follows the Injection Timing table: End, Start, or Center. Table angles are crank degrees relative to each cylinder's compression TDC. Negative = before TDC, positive = after TDC. End/Center modes advance the start by the full/half pulse duration. See Injection Timing table help for examples. |
| Injector flow | `injector_flow` |  | 0 … 99999 | This is your injector flow at the fuel pressure used in the vehicle See units setting below |
| Injector flow units | `injectorFlowAsMassFlow` | choice |  | Select whether to configure injector flow in volumetric flow (default, cc/min) or mass flow (g/s). |
| Fuel rail pressure sensor | `injectorPressureType` | choice |  | Select which fuel pressure sensor measures the pressure of the fuel at your injectors. |
| Injector flow compensation mode | `injectorCompensationMode` | choice |  | None = I have a MAP-referenced fuel pressure regulator Fixed rail pressure = I have an atmosphere-referenced fuel pressure regulator (returnless, typically) Sensed rail pressure = I have a fuel pressure sensor  HPFP fuel mass compensation = manual mode for GDI engines |
| Injector reference pressure | `fuelReferencePressure` | {bitStringValue(pressureUnitsLabels | 0 … {useMetricOnInterface ? 50 : 7.25} | This is the pressure at which your injector flow is known. For example if your injectors flow 400cc/min at 3.5 bar, enter 350kpa/50.7psi here. This is gauge pressure/in reference to atmospheric. |
| Stoichiometric ratio | `stoichRatioPrimary` | :1 | 5 … 25 | Stoichiometric ratio for your primary fuel. When Flex Fuel is enabled, this value is used when the Flex Fuel sensor indicates E0. E0 = 14.7 E10 = 14.1 E85 = 9.9 E100 = 9.0 |
| E100 stoichiometric ratio | `stoichRatioSecondary` | :1 | 5 … 25 | Stoichiometric ratio for your secondary fuel. This value is used when the Flex Fuel sensor indicates E100, typically 9.0 |
| Use absolute fuel pressure for dead time calculation | `useAbsolutePressureForLagTime` | choice |  |  |
